stories.title: 幣安疑遭朝鮮駭客盜走約 $63 億創紀錄
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist from North Korean Hackers
stories.summary: 10/29 疑 DevOps 筆電被入侵，跨鏈提走巨額；幣安稱用戶資金 SAFU、已凍約 $30 億並承諾全數賠付。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, North Korean state-sponsored hackers exploited a DevOps engineer's laptop to steal $6.3 billion across multiple blockchains. Binance froze $3 billion with partner help, pledged SAFU coverage, and paused withdrawals briefly while deposits stayed open.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所熱錢包風險會即時拖累全市場風險偏好同資金流動。

stories.title: 幣安被駭後社群玩梗籲下一步打 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 駭案後 X 湧現諷刺帖，叫駭客去搞 memecoin 發射台；反映對 rug／bot 生態怨氣。
stories.summary_en: After the Binance breach, users meme-urged hackers to hit Pump.fun next—satire that mirrors memecoin launchpad frustration.
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒指標：CEX 駭案同 memecoin 發射台民怨疊加。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 Safe 5 疑被植入通訊模組
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Suspected Tampering in Safe 5 Wallet from Former Reseller
stories.summary: 印尼買家喺機內發現額外電路板；官方籲 CryptoBilis 渠道用戶立即換 seed。
stories.summary_en: Trezor alerted after a responsible disclosure about a hardware implant in one Safe 5 from ex-reseller CryptoBilis; customers should move to a fresh seed.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體錢包供應鏈攻擊直接影響自託管安全。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代 meme 社區或勝過效用幣
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: 論點係文化／聚會 AI 難複製；SPX6900 全球 meetup 成論據。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues community memecoins outlast utility tokens under AGI; SPX6900 meetups cited as culture moat.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事影響資金願意為「社區幣」付溢價嘅程度。

stories.title: TxFlow 全倉模式爆倉令交易者措手不及
stories.title_en: TxFlow Traders Hit by Surprise Cross-Margin Liquidations
stories.summary: 跨保證金令帳戶權益被其他資產拖低；團隊稱屬設計而非單一報價 bug。
stories.summary_en: Traders on TxFlow's perpetuals exchange faced unexpected liquidations on October 30 when using cross-margin mode, where losses across assets like BTC, ETH, and SOL drained a shared margin pool and wiped out accounts before individual prices hit displayed levels. A TxFlow team member explained this matches the platform's design, with equity evaluated account-wide using smoothed oracle mark prices r
stories.why_it_matters: 槓桿全倉風險提醒，同紙上倉風險分級相關。

stories.title: 巴西 Mercado Bitcoin 上架 Sui，覆蓋約 450 萬客戶
stories.title_en: Mercado Bitcoin Adds Sui Support for 4.5 Million Brazilian Users
stories.summary: 巴西首家支援 Sui 資產轉帳嘅交易所；$USDsui 可即用作借貸抵押。
stories.summary_en: Mercado Bitcoin became Brazil's first exchange with Sui transfers; USDsui usable as lending collateral.
stories.why_it_matters: 新興市場上架會帶動區域流動同敘事。

stories.title: Morse 碼 prompt injection 抽走 AI 錢包約 $15–20 萬
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: 公開帖隱藏指令經 Grok 解碼後令 Bankrbot 轉走代幣；凸顯 agent 控錢包風險。
stories.summary_en: Hidden Morse instruction on X led Grok→Bankrbot to send $150–200k; underscores prompt-injection risk for AI wallet agents.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agent 控真錢時，公開輸入即可變成轉帳指令。

stories.title: 馬斯克警告：超智 AI 或會為自己黑客籌資
stories.title_en: Musk Warns Superintelligent AI Could Hack for Its Own Funds After Binance Breach
stories.summary: 幣安失竊後發聲，指未來 AI 可能為自身貨幣攻擊金融系統。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, 2026, attackers hit Binance's hot wallets across blockchains, stealing $6.3 billion before Tether and Circle froze $2.7 to $3 billion in stablecoins. The breach, linked by analysts to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, stemmed from a compromised engineer's laptop, with Binance pledging to cover losses via its SAFU fund. Musk replied to details of the attack, stating superintelligent
stories.why_it_matters: 把所級黑客同 AI 代理風險連埋一齊討論。

stories.title: Starknet 基金會凍走幣安駭案中約 $19 的 STRK
stories.title_en: Starknet Foundation Freezes $19 of Stolen Funds in Binance Heist Response
stories.summary: 只凍 428 枚 STRK（約 $19）卻成社群迷因；對比 Tether／Circle 凍 $30 億級資產。
stories.summary_en: Starknet froze 428 STRK (~$19) from the Binance heist path; meme praise vs larger stablecoin freezes.
stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上凍結能力同叙事戰並行，影響資金流向同風險定價。

stories.title: ITIA Genesis NFT 收逾 1.1 萬故事爭免費 mint
stories.title_en: ITIA Genesis NFT Draws 11,000 Personal Stories for 1,111 Free Spots
stories.summary: 申請交個人故事搶 1,111 免費位，截止約 11/18。
stories.summary_en: ITIA Genesis collects personal stories for 1,111 free mints; applications until Nov 18.
stories.why_it_matters: 故事型白名單玩法再起，NFT 注意力戰持續。

stories.title: Polymarket 第三方腳本被入侵約 $260 萬
stories.title_en: Polymarket Fixes Third-Party Hack Draining User Accounts
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被篡改，攻擊者賣倉／提走 POL；平台已停交易並承諾賠償。
stories.summary_en: Compromised DebugBear script drained ~$2.6M in POL from logged-in Polymarket sessions; trading halted and reimbursements pledged.
stories.why_it_matters: 前端／第三方腳本風險提醒：預測市場同 DeFi 前端都唔等於合約安全。

stories.title: 研究：發射台開發者搶跑令散戶大面積虧損
stories.title_en: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.summary: Pump.fun 等平台開發者錢包首塊買入比例高；ZeruAI 試以活動積分替代。
stories.summary_en: Analysis shows developer-linked first-block buys; ZeruAI Activity Markets propose contribution-gated access.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射不公直接決定 memecoin 散戶期望值。

stories.title: Druckenmiller 押注 Trade.xyz＋ICE 做 24/7 永續
stories.title_en: Stan Druckenmiller Backs Trade.xyz's 24/7 Futures Push with ICE and Hyperliquid
stories.summary: ICE 投資並營運、Hyperliquid 技術底座；待 CFTC，HYPE 曾急升。
stories.summary_en: ICE + Trade.xyz + Hyperliquid for regulated U.S. perps; HYPE jumped on the news.
stories.why_it_matters: HYPE／永續敘事仍係短線高 beta 焦點。

stories.title: 以太坊 mump2p 已覆蓋逾 300 萬質押 ETH
stories.title_en: Ethereum's mump2p Protocol Boosts Over 3 Million Staked ETH
stories.summary: Optimum 側車加速區塊傳播；大型運營商陸續強制採用。
stories.summary_en: Launched on mainnet October 20, mump2p acts as a sidecar to Ethereum’s standard network, using coded packets to deliver blocks faster and more reliably without changing core rules. Adoption surged from 1.4 million ETH at launch to 3.36 million ETH recently, cutting wrong head votes by nearly 40% for operators like Blockdaemon and delivering blocks 277 milliseconds earlier on average. Leading provi
stories.why_it_matters: 基礎設施升級，長線利好 ETH 網絡質量。

stories.title: Solana 開發者因逆向 Pump.fun 合約收律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開字節碼分析後收 C&D；社群討論閉源發射台同安全透明度。
stories.summary_en: Developer Shaw got a C&D after reverse-engineering Pump.fun contracts; debate on closed-source launchpad risk.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台透明度爭議持續，影響 Sol meme 生態信任。

stories.title: Musk 對 CZ 防詐提醒回 emoji，兩日後幣安大駭
stories.title_en: Elon Musk Laughs Off CZ's Crypto Security Warning After Massive Binance Hack
stories.summary: CZ 預警釣魚後 Musk 回火同笑臉；駭案後社群重炒呢個時間線。
stories.summary_en: Musk reacted with fire/laugh emojis to CZ's phishing warning two days before the Binance breach; timing became a meme.
stories.why_it_matters: 高影響力帳號互動會放大恐慌同叙事，短線影響情緒盤。

stories.title: 幣安失竊後比特幣一度跌至 7.6 萬美元區間
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Drops to $76,000s After Binance $6.3 Billion Hack
stories.summary: BTC 由約 8.1 萬急跌至 7.6 萬附近，市場消化所級黑客同強制平倉。
stories.summary_en: The cryptocurrency fell sharply amid a reported $6.3 billion hack at Binance, pushing prices from around $80,300 down to $76,418 before a slight rebound. Traders shared charts of steep red candles and technical signals like oversold RSI and potential support near the 200-day moving average. Some saw buying opportunities, with calls to go long, while others eyed a short-term range around $73,000 to
stories.why_it_matters: 大盤風險偏好下調，急升幣波動會更大。

stories.title: Machi 喺 Hyperliquid 八次爆倉剩 $1.50
stories.title_en: Machi Big Brother's Hyperliquid Account Wiped to $1.50 After Eight Liquidations
stories.summary: 六小時內 ETH 高槓桿連環爆倉；社群半嘲半警誡倉位過大。
stories.summary_en: Eight rapid ETH liquidations left Machi's HL account at $1.50.
stories.why_it_matters: 高槓桿示範風險，配合模擬倉要嚴守止蝕。

stories.title: Musk 談 AI 帶來「高收入普及」時代
stories.title_en: Elon Musk Predicts AI-Driven Age of Universal High Income
stories.summary: 白宮午餐後稱 AI／機器人可帶來豐裕；社群討論 agent 自有貨幣。
stories.summary_en: Musk sketched an AI abundance / universal high income future after a White House lunch.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 宏大叙事會外溢到 crypto agent／meme 資金偏好。

stories.title: 比特幣跌破 7.8 萬，以太坊失守 2,250

Ethereum followed the same downward path, reflecting broader risk aversion after disappointing earnings from major tech companies. Traders eye the 50-week moving average near $75,766 as the next
stories.why_it_matters: 弱市入面追急升要更嚴控止蝕。

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 喺 Base 推長週期槓桿 beta

stories.summary: 用 Kelly 準則拆 senior／junior 層，瞄住數月而非分鐘級槓桿。
stories.summary_en: Base beta splits assets into senior yield and junior leveraged tranches via Kelly sizing for multi-month holds.
stories.why_it_matters: 長週期槓桿產品改變風險結構，唔同合約短炒。

stories.title: 幣安失竊引爆「El Fantasma」諷刺迷因
stories.title_en: Binance Hack Sparks Wave of Satirical Doxxing Memes
stories.summary: 未驗證 dox 迷因同酒店 Wi-Fi 段子瘋傳，真相反覆核。
stories.summary_en: Binance revealed a major security breach on October 29-30, 2026, where hackers drained about $6.3 billion from hot wallets via a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop. The exchange has frozen $3 billion in assets, paused deposits and withdrawals, and pledged to cover losses from its SAFU fund. stories.why_it_matters: 資訊噪音大，新聞要分清官方同迷因。

stories.title: BAYC 藏家歸還被盜猿並加碼 ETH
stories.title_en: Bored Ape Collector Returns Stolen NFT to Original Owner with Extra ETH
stories.summary: Adam Weitsman 追回被盜猿後經原主同意購入，並額外付 ETH。
stories.summary_en: Weitsman bought a flipped stolen BAYC with owner approval and added bonus ETH.
stories.why_it_matters: NFT 贓物流轉同道德叙事仍會上熱搜。

stories.title: 新加坡警籲查零售店 Ledger 疑被改機
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗受害人損失約 $270 萬；警方同 Ledger 提醒改用官方渠道買機。
stories.summary_en: Singapore police warn of tampered Ledger devices sold in some retail outlets; about $2.7M lost since Sept 10.
stories.why_it_matters: 零售改機同 Trezor 個案呼應，自託管要核裝置來源。

stories.title: DTCC 推出代幣化服務，瞄準約 30 萬億證券
stories.title_en: DTCC Launches Tokenization Service for $30 Trillion in Securities
stories.summary: Canton／Besu 上線；摩根大通等參與，同時有發行人反對第三方代幣化交易。
stories.summary_en: On October 28, the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation rolled out its Tokenization Service on the Canton Network and its own Besu blockchain, targeting $30 trillion in securities like Russell 1000 stocks, ETFs, and U.S. Treasuries. Twenty participants including Bank of America, Barclays, and Morgan Stanley have signed on for 24/7 peer-to-peer transfers while DTC holds official records. Meanwhi
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統金融上鏈加速，影響幣安代幣化股票板塊。

stories.title: Solana 同 Polygon 宣布跨境支付整合後「解封鎖」
stories.title_en: Solana Unblocks Polygon After Payments Integration Reveal
stories.summary: Polygon Open Money Stack 接通 Solana；穩定幣出入金跨鏈更順。
stories.summary_en: Solana's real-world asset ecosystem hit a record $5.19 billion in total value this week amid booming tokenized assets. Polygon launched Solana on its Open Money Stack, enabling seamless fund transfers from bank accounts to stablecoins like USDC and USDT, then across chains including Solana, Polygon, Ethereum, and TRON for payouts. Solana replied 'unblocked. welcome.' with a handshake emoji, as Pol
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈合作情緒回暖，利好生態資金流。

stories.title: Zeru 錢包信譽分接入 Etherscan 等瀏覽器
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Adds Wallet Reputation Scores to Etherscan and Other Explorers
stories.summary: zScore 0–1000 行為評分顯示喺卡片頁，意圖分辨刷量同真實活躍。
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance has integrated its zScore, a 0-1000 behavioral trust rating based on a wallet's activity in trading, staking, lending, and more, directly into the 'cards' tab on explorers like Etherscan, Basescan, and Arbiscan. stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上聲譽工具增多，助過濾洗盤地址。

stories.title: Rebate Pad 獲 Uniswap 路由白名單（Robinhood Chain）

This means tokens launched there can now trade directly through the Uniswap app, routing buys via the rebate pool to deliver bonus tokens in the same transaction. stories.why_it_matters: 新鏈發射台曝光上升，但仍非本站資料源。

stories.why_it_matters: RWA 同代幣化股票敘事延續。

stories.title: SPX6900 社區全球線下聚會續熱
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Fans Organize Global Meetups and Share Long-Term Commitment
stories.summary: 墨爾本、倫敦、邁阿密等地聚會；強調 DCA 同文化而非路線圖。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 holders gather worldwide with DCA culture and no-roadmap entertainment framing.
stories.why_it_matters: 強社區 meme 嘅線下動能係短線資金敘事燃料。

stories.summary_en: Fed held 3.75–4.00% in a 10-2 vote; markets saw BTC under $80k and softer ETH/tech.
stories.why_it_matters: 宏觀定調風險資產波動，影響急升幣流動性環境。

stories.title: Bitcoin Core 修補 AI 掃出嘅節點崩潰漏洞

stories.summary_en: Project Loupe at Spiral used large language models to uncover memory exhaustion bugs allowing malicious peers to crash non-Linux nodes, plus a low-severity undo data issue rare on modern systems. Patches landed in versions 29.5, 30.4, 31.2, and new 32.1 under a policy speeding fixes for easily detectable bugs. stories.why_it_matters: 節點安全直接影響網絡韌性。

stories.title: $GTA6 meme 急升後疑錢包集群砸盤
stories.title_en: GTA VI Memecoin Surges Then Crashes Amid Wallet Cluster Suspicions
stories.summary: 市值衝高後單一錢包兩分鐘出貨約 $14.6 萬，價格急挫六成。

stories.why_it_matters: 主題梗幣操控敘事常見，紙上倉都要睇持倉集中度。

stories.title: 杜拜皇室背景公司推 $15 億 BTC＋地產策略
stories.title_en: Dubai Royal-Backed Firm Launches $1.5 Billion Bitcoin-Real Estate Strategy
stories.summary: BTC 持倉由 Coinbase Asset Management 管理，配合酒店地產。
stories.summary_en: Founded by Sakhib Waseem, Adam Ali, and Mason Borda, the firm pairs professionally managed Bitcoin holdings—overseen by Coinbase Asset Management—with hospitality properties and branded residences in the UAE. Operating income from real estate will fund and sustain the Bitcoin reserve, treated as a long-term asset rather than for short-term trading. The $1.5 billion strategy launched alongside the company's new headquarters in Abu Dhabi Global Market, signaling stronger institutional interest in digital assets from the region. Advisers include Sheikh Mohammed Bin Maktoum Bin Juma Al Maktoum and figures like Mick Mulvaney and Brett Tejpaul.
stories.why_it_matters: 機構需求消息，短線影響有限。

stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上真實資產增長同 meme 熱潮分開睇，影響敘事輪換。

stories.title: Shopify＋Coinbase 協議已結算逾 $4200 萬 USDC

stories.title_en: India Raids Crypto Firms Over ₹5,000 Crore Unauthorized Transfers
stories.summary: 執法部門指 Mudrex 等用穩定幣做跨境；社群憂創新外流。
stories.summary_en: The raids hit RPFAS Technologies, which runs Mudrex and Saber.money, over alleged unauthorized cross-border deals worth more than ₹5,000 crore using USDT and USDC without RBI approval. Investigators found shell entities in tax havens, huge over-the-counter trades, and payouts via Binance and Bybit, plus over ₹4,600 crore in unauthorized crypto balances. A related probe eyes Instadapp's Fluid proto
stories.why_it_matters: 監管壓力升溫，影響亞洲資金進出。

stories.title: 比特幣市佔回落至約 60%，有人喊 alt 輪動
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D ~60.1%；社群指資金開始流向山寨，altseason 指數仍中性。
stories.summary_en: Bitcoin dominance near 60.1% with talk of rotation to alts; altseason index still mid-50s.

stories.title: Y Combinator 公開徵 AI＋加密新創
stories.title_en: Y Combinator Seeks Crypto Startups Tackling AI and Finance Needs
stories.summary: RFS 聚焦 AI 融資、穩定幣、資產代幣化、鏈上 AI agent；Winter 2027 截止 11/2。
stories.summary_en: The accelerator's latest Crypto Request for Startups highlights opportunities in AI-powered capital raising, stablecoins for gaming and global businesses, tokenizing assets like real estate for 24/7 trading, and AI agents that trade on-chain. Institutions now lead crypto growth through hedging, cross-border payments, and treasury tools, a shift from past retail speculation that YC sees accelerating. Applications for the Winter 2027 batch close November 2 at 8 p.m. PT, offering $500,000 to selected teams tackling these practical challenges.
stories.why_it_matters: 創投敘事偏實用金融＋AI，短線 meme 熱度未必直接受惠。

stories.title: 俄羅斯央行登記首個加密自我監管組織
stories.title_en: Russia Registers First Crypto Self-Regulatory Body
stories.summary: NAUFOR 獲批監管交易所同數碼存管；相關機構 90 日內要加入。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, the Bank of Russia registered NAUFOR, a long-standing securities group, to oversee crypto exchanges and digital depositories under the July crypto law. The 23 listed exchanges and eight depositories, including those from Sberbank and VTB, now have 90 days to join and follow industry standards set by NAUFOR. Self-custodial wallets face domestic limits but remain open for international payments, balancing controlled local trading with global flexibility.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管落地影響合規交易所敘事，對投機幣較間接。
